runs.question: Which beacon nodes does Forky have fork-choice snapshots for on sepolia right now, and what consensus clients are they running?
runs.answer:
All 4 beacon nodes on sepolia have fork-choice snapshots right now:

| Node | Consensus Client |
|------|-----------------|
| `utility-sepolia-lighthouse-geth-001` | **Lighthouse** |
| `utility-sepolia-nimbus-besu-001` | **Nimbus** |
| `utility-sepolia-prysm-reth-001` | **Prysm** |
| `utility-sepolia-teku-erigon-001` | **Teku** |

Every slot (10689661–10689665) shows frames captured from all four nodes within the same second, all via `xatu_polling`.

runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_096710773ffe4NyM5uSJmzTGQ4] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the **first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026** (7,180 slots, per-slot fastest observer):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Slots observed | 7,180 (full day) |
| Min arrival | **141 ms** |
| Median arrival | **1,453 ms** |
| P95 arrival | **3,126 ms** |
| Max arrival | **5,249 ms** |
| Avg arrival | **1,710 ms** |

**By consensus client** (median arrival, fastest to slowest):

| Client | Median | P95 | Nodes |
|---|---|---|---|
| **tysm** | 1,595 ms | 3,269 ms | 15 |
| **prysm** | 1,638 ms | 3,259 ms | 51 |
| *(unknown)* | 1,656 ms | 3,281 ms | 11 |
| **lighthouse** | 1,687 ms | 3,329 ms | 26 |
| **caplin** | 1,744 ms | 3,401 ms | 3 |
| **teku** | 1,750 ms | 3,421 ms | 16 |
| **nimbus** | 1,779 ms | 3,475 ms | 31 |
| **grandine** | 1,789 ms | 3,451 ms | 3 |
| **lodestar** | 1,850 ms | 3,481 ms | 21 |

tysm had the fastest median first-seen arrival, though it only observed 3,775 of the 7,180 slots. prysm had the broadest coverage (all slots, 51 nodes).

[Turn 2 | session=ses_096710773ffe4NyM5uSJmzTGQ4] Plot the distribution of those arrival times as a chart.
Chart rendered and uploaded:

- **URL**: http://127.0.0.1:2480/api/v1/storage/files/e2b1da45c9f2/26e8ed84-78b5-4173-af59-6468b0bd4666/arrival_distribution.png
- **Path**: `/home/runner/.panda/data/storage/e2b1da45c9f2/26e8ed84-78b5-4173-af59-6468b0bd4666/arrival_distribution.png`

The histogram shows the distribution of per-slot fastest first-seen arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026. The bulk of blocks arrive between ~1–2 s, with a long tail stretching past 4 s (Median: 1,453 ms, P95: 3,126 ms).
